commits.author: elijah-shard
commits.subject: Add document AI, per-user access control and repository tooling
commits.title: Add document AI, per-user access control and repository tooling
bodyLines: Document AI
Gemini with an OpenRouter fallback so an exhausted daily quota no longer
stops all analysis
Uploads are read automatically; title, document number, office, subject
and author are filled in without pressing a button
A signature checklist is built from the signatories the document names, with
progress measured over required signatures only
An author never signs their own paper: names found beside prepared-by,
drafted-by or recorded-by are identified and kept off the approval list
Progress and status are recomputed server-side, so the browser cannot
assert approval on an unsigned document
Document status reduced to Pending, Under Review and Approved, all
human-assignable
Institution supplied to the model so a CTU Daanbantayan letterhead is
recognised and no other institution is substituted
Access control
Per-user permission overrides: grant or revoke access for one person
without inventing a role
Role claims synced onto the ID token so Storage rules can authorise,
which is what unblocked uploads
Officer-only roster verification; a recorder cannot certify their own
remittance
Repository tooling
preflight command that checks configuration, build, emulator, providers
and the whole suite, naming the broken link
Emulator suites for rules, documents, storage claims, migration, quota,
capacity, fallback and theme tokens
Migration of legacy Base64 PDFs into Storage: dry run by default,
idempotent, never deletes the source
Theme tokens applied to every screen, verified against all three themes
Fixes
Storage rules now read the app's project id so the emulator answers
instead of returning a 404 that surfaced as a bogus CORS failure
Document status constants moved inside the function bundle; importing
them from the app worked locally and would have broken on deploy
Local file store stores blobs in IndexedDB rather than localStorage,
which could hold roughly two PDFs

commits.author: elijah-shard
commits.subject: Add classroom roster registry and Death Aid accountability workflow
commits.title: Add classroom roster registry and Death Aid accountability workflow
bodyLines: Roster registry
Flexible importer for CSV/XLS/XLSX that detects Name and Section columns
by content rather than position, ignores unrelated columns, tolerates title
rows above the header, and flags duplicates and suspicious entries
Sectional browsing by college and year level with on-demand student lists
Submissions are unverified proposals until an officer approves; verified
rosters are versioned and their student lists frozen
Death Aid
Count-based collection recording: enrolled count comes from the verified
roster, the officer enters beneficiaries paid, and expected/collected/outstanding
are all derived rather than typed
Debtor records can be named, unidentified, absent or left-early, and may
be completed later without altering the counted figures
Remittance verification records the receiving officer and compares reported
against received, preserving both on a discrepancy
Outstanding balance is derived from the latest filing per section, so the
figures can never drift from the collections that produced them
Access control
Added governor role and canViewRosters, restricted roster reading to
Governors, Secretary and Admin plus a submitter's own roster
Per-user permission overrides so access can be granted or revoked for an
individual without inventing a role
Submitter rights: may amend a pending roster, withdraw their own submission,
or amend a verified roster for declared transfers, which forces re-verification
Infrastructure
firestore.rules covering the new collections, including arithmetic
invariants and an append-only audit log
firebase.json and composite indexes
Emulator-based test suites for rules, queries, calculations, roster import
and the sync call contract
Pinned rollup to 4.62.5; 4.63 breaks Vite 7 builds
Moved off the unmaintained npm xlsx mirror to SheetJS CE 0.20.3, clearing the
prototype pollution and ReDoS advisories in file parsing
Forced @grpc/grpc-js to 1.14.5, since Firebase still pins the vulnerable range
